head: d1fef6cb76f64e6b1987eb705d0432df0c59c4fc
headNote: The independent report reviewed 18319cc5. Root checked the three-file in-PR amendment to d1fef6cb and accepted that exact head. No second independent full-head review is claimed.

fixes.F1: M1 closed key envelope (object, non-empty ciphertext/iv/salt, algorithm text, json_remove IS {}).
fixes.F2: M2 typeof integer guard with BETWEEN lo AND 9007199254740991 on generation, failed_attempts, locked_until_ms, result_generation.
fixes.F3: L1/L2 rows for result_generation 0, 65-char label and 129-char operation id (reviewer survivors R12/R15/R16 now caught as A12-A14).
fixes.F4: L3 revoked_at IS NULL OR non-blank.
fixes.F5: L5/L7 wording: real afcbd62 older build re-run here; no column is named for a password or secret, instead of no column can hold one.
fixes.F6: L4 UNIQUE INDEX (seat_id, result_generation); CF-LSC1DB-2 discharged in-PR.

postReviewAmendment.method: amend-old.cjs: the post-review test file run once against the 18319cc5 migration module (byte copy, swapped in and restored in a finally) and once against the new module, under one heavy-run ticket.

failing: SQLiteService local seat credentials migration > review F1: refuses extra plaintext members, empty members and non-object envelopes
SQLiteService local seat credentials migration > review F2: refuses non-integer fence and lockout values but coerces numeric text
SQLiteService local seat credentials migration > review F3/F4/F6: caps, positive result generation, non-empty revocation and one operation per seat generation

firstSweep.note: The first post-fix sweep caught 29/34: A7 (expected equivalent) plus D9, D11, D12 and D13 survived because the new rules masked two existing rows. The F6 unique index rejected the duplicate-operation row before the primary key did (D9), and the now-required algorithm member rejected the iv/salt rows before the NULL-passing member check (D11-D13). Fix in the test leaf only: the iv/salt rows now carry algorithm, and a row reuses an operation id on a different seat and generation. The old-head leg of that first run also failed to compile because the 18319cc5 module copy had been written UTF-16 by a shell redirect; it was regenerated byte-exact and both legs re-run.

postReviewAmendment.equivalentMutants: A7 (drop json_type object) is expected EQUIVALENT: the member IS text clauses already require an object; the clause is kept as the reviewer specified, for readability.

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1DB-1: integer binds, CAS by changes===1, and the revoke-keeps / re-provision-clears test -> LSC-1S.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1DB-1 (-> LSC-1S): repository writes must bind integers for generation/failed_attempts/locked_until_ms/result_generation and compare CAS by changes === 1; add a test that a stale expected generation leaves the row untouched and that revoke preserves failed_attempts/locked_until_ms while re-provision resets both to 0 (CF-LSC0-8 remainder).

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1DB-2: the one-op-per-generation race test -> LSC-1S. The schema part is done.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1DB-2 (-> LSC-1S): if F6 is not taken in-PR, enforce one recorded operation per (seat_id, result_generation) in the repository transaction and test the lost-CAS race.
items.note: Schema uniqueness discharged in-PR; lost-CAS race remains LSC-1S.

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1DB-3: revocation means revoked_at IS NOT NULL; the clock source for locked_until_ms -> LSC-1S.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1DB-3 (-> LSC-1S): define revocation as revoked_at IS NOT NULL (never ''), and treat locked_until_ms with the same clock source as the writer; document clock-rollback behaviour (I2).

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1DB-4: the CF-LSC0-6 remainder (request-scoped key, no-secret logging) -> LSC-1S/1.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1DB-4 (-> LSC-1S / LSC-1): CF-LSC0-6 remainder as routed: decrypted key never outlives the request; no password, derived key or private key in logs, error payloads or operation rows; mutants on the redaction path. The schema's hex-only fingerprint and closed envelope (after F1) are the persistence share.

- CF-LSC1DB-5 (-> LSC-1S / LSC-1): CF-LSC0-16 as routed: post-lock-expiry counter semantics and whether locked/concurrent refusals consume the route-wide window; the schema stores only per-seat count and deadline.

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1DB-6: record manual down SQL -> future schema units.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1DB-6 (-> any later schema change): there is no down in IMigration; if a later unit alters these tables, record the manual down SQL in its receipt as this unit did.

LSC-1S.rules: No secrets in logs/errors/operation rows; request-scoped decrypted key; revoke keeps lock, re-provision clears lock; define post-expiry counter and locked/concurrent refusal window consumption.
